headline: AI SELLOFF
dek: The Nasdaq fell more than 4% in early trading as chipmakers led a broad slide, Reuters reports.

graphic.title: INTRADAY DROP · AS OF 9:53 A.M. ET, NOV. 25
graphic.note: Intraday moves, not closing prices. Bars share one scale.

means.label: Why:
means.text: Traders doubt the debt-fueled AI and data-center buildout can earn enough back. The U.S. also proposed new tariffs on 14 major trading partners, including an added 20% on China, Reuters reports.

means.label: Your money:
means.text: Retirement accounts tied to the S&P 500 are down sharply this month. The Nasdaq and S&P 500 are on track for their worst November since 2008.

means.label: This week:
means.text: Markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving, with a shortened session Friday.

sources: Sources: Reuters, Nov. 25 (prices as of 9:53 a.m. ET); AP, Nov. 25.
